trip.title: Rarotonga Honeymoon

lodging.name: Sea Change Villas
lodging.notes: Primary home base in Titikaveka. Favor slow mornings, private villa time, nearby beach/lagoon time, and easy returns after excursions.

transportPlan.arrival: Late night arrival on Friday, October 9, 2026. Arrival transfer details TBD.
notes: Use driver days preferentially for farther north and west-side destinations.
Keep nearby south/east/Titikaveka/Muri activities for rental-car days.
Use the rental car for flexible local logistics from October 13 onward.

preferred.name: Raemaru Trek
preferred.notes: Optional fixed-rope scramble near the summit.

alternative.name: Northern Cross-Island Track to the base of The Needle and back
alternative.notes: Use as an alternative to the full Cross-Island Track.

hikeOptions.avoid: Do not schedule the full 4-hour Cross-Island Track.
hikeOptions.placement: Likely October 14 or October 15, preferably the day without Antipodes and only if weather/flexibility supports it.

planningPhilosophy: Anchor each day around confirmed bookings.
Keep honeymoon pacing relaxed rather than checklist-driven.
Preserve buffers before and after scheduled activities.
Use chauffeur time for broader island exploration, not simple nearby transfers.
Use the rental car for flexible south/east/Titikaveka/Muri logistics from October 13 onward.
Mix romantic dinners with casual food and unstructured time.
Aim for roughly 3-4 standout dinners, 2-3 major activities, and substantial flexible beach/villa time.
Do not add another fine-dining reservation automatically.
Do not add another turtle or lagoon wildlife excursion automatically.

days.title: West and North Island Day
days.summary: Use driver time for a broader north/west island day with beaches, Aroa, Arorangi, Black Rock, drinks or lunch, then confirmed Tamarind House main restaurant dinner.

events.title: Driver-based north/west island exploration
events.notes: Potential stops include Aroa, Arorangi, Black Rock, beach hopping, and scenic drink/lunch stops. Use driver time for destinations farther from Titikaveka.

events.title: Dinner at Tamarind House main restaurant
events.notes: Confirmed reservation at the main restaurant, not Ukulele Bar.

days.transport: Driver / car service planned for the daytime north/west exploration and dinner logistics as needed.
days.notes: Do not add another major activity around the confirmed dinner.

days.title: West-Side Beach Day and OTB
days.summary: A west-side day using the driver for beach, snorkeling, and exploration, ending with OTB / On the Beach Bar & Restaurant dinner and sunset.

events.title: West-side beach and lagoon time
events.notes: Beach, snorkeling, and west-side exploration are the main shape of the day. Use driver time for the farther west-side routing.

events.title: Dinner at OTB / On the Beach Bar & Restaurant
events.notes: Confirmed reservation; exact time not provided. Keep this as a west-side-focused day ending with dinner/sunset.

days.transport: Driver / car service planned. Confirm exact dinner transport timing once OTB time is known.
days.notes: Keep enough time to return, shower, and change before dinner.

days.title: Slow Morning and Turtle Snorkel
days.summary: Rental car begins. A deliberately light local day anchored by the 2:30 PM turtle snorkel at Avaavaroa Passage / Takitumu.

events.title: Slow morning at Sea Change Villas
events.notes: Villa breakfast, private pool, Titikaveka lagoon time, or rest.

events.title: Lunch near the south side
events.notes: Charlie's is a good candidate for a convenient nearby lunch.

events.title: Swim With The Turtles Rarotonga
events.notes: Transportation is not included. Confirm exact meeting/check-in instructions from booking.

events.title: Easy dinner
events.notes: No fancy reservation. Shower, relax, then choose takeaway, nearby casual food, or Muri.

days.transport: Rental car starts today and is ideal. Build in buffer to arrive and check in before 2:30 PM.
days.notes: Do not schedule another turtle/snorkeling excursion elsewhere. Do not stack this day with another full activity. The turtle snorkel is the anchor.

days.title: Adventure Day or Antipodes
days.summary: Flexible major activity day. Possible Raemaru Trek or other land-based activity if weather cooperates. Antipodes may land here if confirmed.

events.title: Flexible hike or land-based activity
events.notes: Preferred hike is Raemaru Trek, about 1.5-2 hours, moderate, west side near Arorangi, with optional fixed-rope scramble near the summit. Alternative is the northern Cross-Island Track to the base of The Needle and back, about 2.5 hours and more rugged. Do not schedule the full 4-hour Cross-Island Track.

events.title: Antipodes dinner
events.notes: Pending for either October 14 or October 15. Prefer early/sunset timing if confirmed.

days.transport: Rental car. Choose routing based on weather, hike choice, and whether Antipodes lands here.
days.notes: Prefer hiking on the day without Antipodes. Remove turtle snorkeling from this day because it is already booked for October 13.

days.title: Flexible Honeymoon Day or Antipodes
days.summary: A flexible honeymoon day for lagoon, beach, recovery, and unplanned time. Antipodes may land here if confirmed.

events.title: Lagoon / beach / villa day
events.notes: Protect this day unless Antipodes, weather, or the optional hike reshuffling requires changes. If Antipodes is on October 14, keep this day especially open.

events.title: Optional hike if not done October 14
events.notes: Raemaru Trek is preferred if weather and energy are right. Prefer the hike on whichever day does not have Antipodes.

events.title: Antipodes dinner
events.notes: Pending for either October 14 or October 15. Prefer early/sunset timing if confirmed.

days.transport: Rental car or taxi as needed.
days.notes: This is the buffer day before Aitutaki and should not become overbuilt.
